All members should read this page prior to submitting a post or comment on this subverse. This page outlines the rules of our community, how to report comments, and other information regarding how our subverse works.

If you have a correction, addition, suggestion, or question about any of the below information, please message the moderators.

Rules and Guidelines

Please be sure to read through Voat's FAQ for site wide policies.

Please be sure to report any posts or comments you see that break one of these rules. While the moderators do their best to be online frequently and view as many posts as we can, we simply cannot catch everything. We rely on the members of this subverse to help us keep this community safe and comfortable.

1.Play nice.This is our most important rule and includes a number of “sub-rules” but basically boils down to respecting each other and this community.

  • Don’t swear at another member
  • Don’t start drama
  • Think about how others might interpret your comments; bras and breasts can be a sensitive subject and offhanded comments can have negative consequences that you might not think about at first
  • Try to answer the question that the OP is asking, instead of only requesting measurements, when possible
  • Try not to repeat advice that another user has already given if you have nothing to add - this can overwhelm new members or make them feel ganged up on
  • Don’t take it personally if your advice is corrected - we’re all here to learn and learning from our mistakes is part of that
  • On the other hand, when you are correcting someone, do so politely - no one is an expert on their first day, and that’s okay

2.Don't post pictures of naked breasts. Additionally, while pictures of breasts in a bra are allowed, they should be posted inside of text posts, not as link posts.

3.Don’t post pictures of others without their permission. This includes celebrities, other public figures, cross posts from other subverses and strangers you come across in your day to day life. Basically, if it isn't you (or it isn't someone who has given you explicit permission to post the picture), don't post it. The only exception to this rule is ads/models on websites, and only if they are posted without the intention of critiquing the fit of the bra, as well as resources like the Bra Band Project that are used to educate/explain concepts of bra fitting.

4.Please only request pictures when they will actually be helpful (ex. not for measurement checks) If you do feel pictures would be helpful, be sure to stress that they are not required and the woman should only post them if she is comfortable doing so. Be sure to keep the Underage Policy in mind when you do request pictures (we do not allow any pictures from women under 18).

5.No bodyshaming. This is an absolute rule.

6.No creeps. This is an absolute rule as well.

7.Please do not downvote a comment because the advice given is wrong. On our subverse, the only time you should downvote is if it is spam or breaks a rule.

8.Please read through the sidebar before posting general questions. Measurement and Fit Checks are always welcome, as they are very individualized.

9.Please read our How to Ask for Help page before posting - this will help you ensure your title is effective and you are including all of the information we need to help you. In particular, please:

  • Use a tag in your title
  • Be as specific as possible in your title
  • Include all relevant information (i.e. measurements, breast shape, bras you have previously tried [size, brand, model] and how they fit, etc.)
  • Certain kinds of reposts are not allowed. Please be assured that Measurement Checks, Fit Checks, etc. are always welcome. We are always willing to give personalized advice, so never be afraid to post about these kinds of topics. That being said, certain news articles, funny images, etc. can be posted multiple times on our subreddit without really adding any new discussion. For this reason, these kinds of posts may not be reposted until at least 2 months has passed since the last time it was posted. Discussion (text-only) posts generally do not fall under this category.
Reporting Comments/Posts

If you see a rude/creepy/otherwise rule breaking post/comment, please do not just downvote it, message to the moderator Otterhugs about it as well. Doing so ensures that we will be aware of the situation. Even if you think someone else may have already reported it, if it truly breaks a rule (particularly creeps and bodyshamers), you should still report it yourself.

Underage Policy

These guidelines are meant to ensure that /v/abrathatfits remains a safe environment for bra wearers of all ages. Here are some guidelines for posting if you are under the age of 18. Note that your post may be removed by the moderators if it does not comply with these guidelines.

1.Do not share your age. It is not necessary that we know your age to help you find a properly fitting bra. Sharing your age puts you at an increased risk of unwanted contact.

2.Do not post pictures of yourself. Although pictures can be helpful in addressing fit issues, they are 100% not necessary. Instead, provide a thorough description of your fit issues. If asked to post pictures, ignore the request and report the comment to the mods if you feel that is necessary. We take this very seriously - your post may be reported and images removed by the mods if there is a concern about the content posted.

We have a 100% prohibition on images posted by users who are under the age of 18 - this rule is necessary to protect the reputation and viability of this community. For guidelines on how to ask for fit check advice without posting pictures, see the corresponding section in What to Include in Fit Checks.

See the What to Include in Fit Checks section for information on staying anonymous.

Manufacturer/Retailer Guidelines

If you are a representative of a company that manufacturers lingerie/related products, or own/work (on commission) for a store that sells lingerie/related products, please read and comply with the following additional guidelines:

  1. Verify your account - Please verify your affiliation with the manufacturer/retailer you are representing with the moderators of this subverse. You may do so by sending an email to abtfits@gmail.com from an official email address, being sure to let us know which username(s) you are verifying.

  2. You may choose to have an alternate account separate from your official account. However, you must let the moderators know the username of the alternate account as well. If you choose to provide fit advice, you must do so from an alt, not your official account. Please do not use your alternate account to promote your product.

  3. Posting: The following charts list posts and comments that are and are not allowed to be submitted by manufacturer/retailer accounts. If the topic of your post/comment is not listed here, or you are still unsure where your post/comment would fall, please message the moderators for permission to post. Please remember that although sales and other PSAs are allowed, you should use unbiased language, and simply tell us the facts about the sale/upcoming product.
